s.how: Roast 1kg pork shoulder rubbed with garlic, rosemary and fennel seeds at 160C for 3 hours, rest and slice thin. Fry 2 bunches broccolini with 3 garlic cloves and chilli. Pile the pork, greens and 150g sliced provolone into 12 slider buns and spoon over the pan juices.

s.note: the little red tent in Cole's room
s.how: Dip 500g dry strawberries in 150g melted dark chocolate. Before it sets, roll half of each in crushed freeze-dried raspberries so they're bright red. Chill on baking paper until set.

m.note: Malcolm late to his own anniversary dinner
m.how: Heat the oven to 220C. Boil 800g baby potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and crush with olive oil and salt. Season 4 salmon fillets and roast skin side down on an oiled tray for 8 minutes. Meanwhile simmer 1 finely diced shallot in 100ml white wine and 2 tbsp white wine vinegar until about 2 tbsp is left, then whisk in 150g cold diced butter a piece at a time over low heat. Blanch 2 bunches of asparagus for 2 minutes. Plate up and spoon the sauce over the fish.

w.note: the room goes cold when they're close
w.how: Melt 150g white chocolate into 100ml warm cream and cool. Fold through 200ml whipped cream and 1 whisked egg white. Spoon into glasses and set 4 hours. Top with a few raspberries.

d.n: Philly winter hot spiced apple cider
d.how: Pour 1.5 litres cloudy apple juice into a pot with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 3 star anise, 1 sliced orange and 2 tbsp brown sugar. Bring to a simmer, then keep it just below simmering for 20 minutes. Strain into mugs and add a cinnamon stick and an orange slice to each. Stir 30ml dark rum into the adults' mugs if you like.
